name: Kayupulau
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

sources.citation: Suharyanto. 2010. Perbandingan Sistem Fonologi Bahasa Indonesia dengan Bahasa Kayu Pulau. Kibas Cenderawasih 6(1): 17-24. Jayapura: Balai Bahasa Papua.
sources.note: Nothing language-specific. Gives Kayu Pulau segmental inventory (20 consonant, 7 vowel phonemes; allophones of /k/, /i/, /o/) after Suharyanto 2009:91-93; 'tekanan (stress)' appears only in a generic textbook definition of suprasegmentals (p.18). Silent on where Kayu Pulau stress falls.

sources.citation: Maturbongs, Anton. 2009. Pergeseran Bahasa Kayo Pulau di Kota Jayapura yang Terancam Punah: Fakta, Sebab, Gejala, dan Strategi Pemeliharaannya. Kibas Cenderawasih 5(2).
sources.note: Sociolinguistic language-shift paper; no phonology, no stress.

sources.citation: Donohue, Mark. 2002. Tobati. In Lynch, Ross & Crowley (eds.), The Oceanic Languages, 186-203. Richmond: Curzon.
sources.note: About the sister language Tobati (not Kayupulau): p.189 'Primary stress in Tobati regularly falls on the penultimate syllable.' The volume only lists Kayupulau in the subgrouping table; no Kayupulau data.
